label: preparing
what: The baker is fulfilling an eighty-loaf freight order (32 delivered, 18 collected, final 30 baked). Builder supplied the baker with lantern and planks, but the evidence does not establish that this is part of the bread order. Rumours of a bridge or port change appear unsupported; builder's evening hall-lighting inspection was openly scheduled, not concealed preparation. The bread order itself was coordinated, but there is no evidence it was being kept from the mayor. Neighbour and secretary helped clarify/record information, not knowingly assist the preparation. Thus, no well-supported secret preparation not disclosed to the mayor; the bread order is the only evident coordinated activity.
